EVAL-CT-M3-S1.title: Define Relevance Scoring Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M3-S1.description: Define structured schema for trial relevance including condition_match_score, eligibility_match_score, composite relevance_score, and explainability fields. Extend Pydantic models for strict validation of inputs and outputs.

EVAL-CT-M3-S2.title: Implement Condition and Eligibility Matching Logic
EVAL-CT-M3-S2.description: Build core logic to compare user query intent against trial condition fields and eligibility criteria, including normalization, keyword and partial matching, and structured parsing of inclusion vs exclusion criteria to produce condition_match_score, eligibility_match_score, and explainability artifacts.

EVAL-CT-M3-S5.title: Integrate Relevance Scoring into Clinical Trials Service Flow
EVAL-CT-M3-S5.description: Embed relevance computation into clinical_trials_service pipeline so each trial result includes computed relevance signals prior to being returned upstream.

EVAL-CT-M3-S3.title: Expose Relevance Signals via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M3-S3.description: Integrate relevance scoring output into evaluate_care_facade responses so downstream consumers receive structured relevance indicators for each trial.

EVAL-CT-M3-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Relevance Matching Logic
EVAL-CT-M3-S4.description: Create unit and integration tests validating condition matching, eligibility parsing (including inclusion vs exclusion criteria), scoring accuracy, partial matches, explainability outputs, and end-to-end service + facade integration including edge cases.
